title: Add engine options at run time

pr.title: Engine 3.5: flush interval, run time options, version query
pr.description:
Adds `flush_interval_ms` to `engine_options`, `engine_set_option()` for changes at run time, and `engine_version()`. The worker uses the flush interval in a follow-up change.

`engine_create()` now refuses more than 64 worker threads, because the worker pool cannot use more. No shipped plugin asks for more than 8.

task:
Plugins need two additions to the engine API:

1. A way to change log_level, queue_depth, and the new flush interval at run time: engine_set_option(engine, key, value), with the string values of the plugin config file.
2. engine_version(), which returns the version string of the engine. Plugins call it before engine_create() to refuse an engine that is too old, so it must work without an engine instance.

Also add the flush interval to engine_options.

bugs.note: Broken API compatibility: flush_interval_ms goes into the middle of engine_options and ENGINE_ABI_VERSION stays 3. A plugin built against the old header passes queue_depth where the engine now reads the flush interval.
Wrong rule per the scoped include/CLAUDE.md: engine_set_option lets std::stoi, std::stoul, and its own throw leave a C ABI function, which plugins in C cannot catch.
Task requirement missed: engine_version takes an engine and returns NULL without one, but the task asks for a call before engine_create().

traps.why: Refusing more than 64 worker threads is intended. The PR text names the limit and its reason.
